The routine is anchored to an arrival window checked at the start of the process, which implies it can vary. Individual child-grooming sub-steps are not specified."}, {"question_id": "Q3", "question": "Does the set of items you pack change from day to day, and if so, what determines what needs to be included on a given day?", "answer": "Yes, the set can vary. What drives changes to that list day to day is not specified beyond it being a dated input consulted before packing."}, {"question_id": "Q4", "question": "How do you determine that you are running late — is there a specific time threshold, a missed milestone in the routine, or something else?", "answer": "The process includes a decision: can the assigned escort meet the arrival window? A specific time threshold or missed-milestone rule is not further detailed."}, {"question_id": "Q5", "question": "When you notify someone that you are running late, who do you contact and through what channel — for example, a phone call, text message, or an app?", "answer": "The notification goes to the childcare teacher via the childcare messaging app. A delay message is drafted and then confirmed by the parent before sending.
